newsitem.title: CHINA: China province executes 18 for drugs in one day.
newsitem.headline: China province executes 18 for drugs in one day.

text.p: China's southwestern province of Yunnan executed 18 people in a single day this week for trafficking and peddling drugs, the China News Service said on Friday.
The 18 were put to death shortly after sentencing on Wednesday by the Intermediate People's Court in Kunming, provincial capital of Yunnan, the news agency said.
Police had seized 11.3 kg (25 lb) of heroin from the death-row convicts, it said but gave no further details.
Yunnan borders the notorious opium-growing Golden Triangle region that includes parts of Burma, Laos and northern Thailand.
Drug abuse, virtually wiped out in China in the years after the communists came to power in 1949, has surged in the past decade along with economic reforms.
The vast majority of China's estimated 500,000 addicts and abusers live in Yunnan.
China has executed more than 1,000 people since launching a nationwide "Strike Hard" campaign against crime in late April.
